error.activation_refused: The cloud did not accept that code. Check it against the console — it must be for this store — or issue a new one there; each code works once.
error.activation_unavailable: Activation did not go through: this store server could not reach the cloud, or could not store its credential. Check its internet connection and try again.
error.activation_wrong_state: The cloud says this code or device is in the wrong state. Issue a new code in the console and try again.
error.already_activated: This store server is already activated.
error.already_fired: Already sent to the kitchen — it can no longer be refused.
error.approval_refused: That manager PIN cannot authorise this.

error.capability_disabled: This store does not use that feature.
error.channel_not_accepted: This store does not take orders on that channel. Check the channels published for it in the console.
error.empty: Nothing to do yet — add an item or a payment first.
error.internal: Something went wrong on the store PC. Try again; if it repeats, call support.
error.invalid_argument: The request was not understood. Reload and try again.
error.item_not_sellable: That item cannot be sold right now: it is not on this store's menu, or it has run out.
error.modifier_selection_invalid: The choices for this item are incomplete or not allowed.
error.negative_change: The amount tendered is less than the amount applied to the bill.

error.permission_denied: Your role is not allowed to do this.
error.reason_not_valid: Pick a reason from the list.
error.reduction_exceeds_bill: That discount would take the bill below zero.
error.shift_already_open: A shift is already open. Count and close it first.
error.split_not_a_partition: Each item must be on exactly one part of the split.
error.store_unavailable: The store could not save that. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the store PC or call support.
error.superseded: This machine has been replaced. Finish what is open here and take new orders on the new machine.
error.tax_rate_not_configured: This item has no tax rate set up. Ask a manager to check the menu.
error.transition_refused: That is not possible right now — the table or bill may have changed. Reload and try again.
error.unknown_record: That item, order or bill has changed on another device. Reload and try again.
error.unknown_shift: That shift is no longer open. Reload the shift screen.
error.unroutable_line: No kitchen station takes this item. Ask a manager to check the station setup.
